stem: How is the article “Acoustic Sculpture, Sound Art, and the Music of the Sea” organized to develop the thesis?
instruction: Use “Acoustic Sculpture, Sound Art, and the Music of the Sea” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: The development and history of the Wave Organ and “Kirribilli Wharf” are compared in order to distinguish them and illustrate the influence one had on the other.

options.label: B
options.text: The biographies of Richards and Fontana are contrasted in order to examine how the life experience of each helped shape their artistic creations.

options.label: C
options.text: A chronological history of the Wave Organ’s development is provided to show how difficult it was to create.

options.label: D
options.text: An advantages-and-disadvantages approach is used to weigh the value of one form of sound art against the other.
